name: Knee — strength and control
for: A knee past the early weeks, or knee arthritis: the thigh and hip strong, the knee tracking well
blurb: Closed-chain strength in a range the knee likes: shallow, slow and controlled. Three times a week, with a rest day between.
notes: Depth is not the aim: a quarter squat worked well beats a deep one that hurts.
Knees over the second toe, never collapsing inward.
Add a step height, a slower lowering or a light weight before adding depth.

sources.title: Royal Orthopaedic Hospital — exercises for osteoarthritis of the knee

items.note: A shallow lunge; skip it on a sore day.
